facts.fact: The AfDB implementation report of September 2025 says the project developed VAT, PAYE and CIT e-filing, and that all clients were trained on filing all tax types on the e-filing platforms.
The AfDB implementation report of September 2025 lists e-payment integration with a payment gateway among the e-taxation solutions the project developed.
facts.system: e-tax engine with payment gateway integration

systems.system: e-tax engine (VAT, PAYE, CIT e-filing, e-registration, payment gateway)
